methodology: Actual packed geometry/skin/morph decoded through Babylon GLTFFileLoader and actual BossModelLibrary/Encounter preparation. Images/KTX omitted.
NullEngine native buffer/raw methods instrumented; texture-array API uses an inert raw texture shim. One logical texture-array call is recorded once, not again through the shim.
inputBytes counts CPU input payload, not measured VRAM. Number arrays use a four-byte-per-value proxy; typed-array byte counts are exact.
CPU call durations exclude audit SHA hashing but are not representative frame times. No GPU upload or driver completion measurement is possible.
